why: Pilot images came out dark (mean luma 37.6/255) because every prompt carried 'deep blacks, warm gold light' and 'dark negative space'. The free grade pass (learn-thumbs/grade.mjs) rescued 10 of 20; these are the lessons it could not rescue (84-91% near-black, gray, or off the department brief), plus the six Explore by Topic covers. Owner direction 2026-11-24: brighter, richer, more diverse color; natural daylight; scenery; expressive, clearly visible faces; meaningful Black representation; a personality per department. Revised the same day on the owner's word: grading only brightens, so the ART DIRECTION itself changes — high-key natural daylight, blue skies, modern well-lit spaces, natural skin tones and natural color; no candlelight, night, silhouettes, sunsets or brown/orange casts. Three samples are generated first; the other thirteen only after the samples are checked.

lessons.prompt: Bright modern airport control tower at midday, panoramic glass windows full of clear blue sky, sunlit runways and a white airliner taxiing outside. A confident Black woman engineer in her forties, crisp white shirt and lanyard, stands at a clean console checking a tablet before making a change, calm expressive face clearly visible, a younger Black male colleague in a sky-blue shirt beside her pointing at the tablet. Fresh natural daylight, vivid blues and whites, airy and hopeful.
lessons.alt: A Black woman engineer and her colleague check a tablet in a bright airport control tower with planes on a sunlit runway outside.

lessons.prompt: Vibrant, brightly lit modern data center aisle with white floors and glossy server racks glowing with electric cyan, teal and violet LED light, crisp bright overhead lighting. A focused Black woman security engineer in her thirties, natural hair, teal jacket, holds a tablet up to a rack, scanning it, her alert expression clearly lit, reflections of colorful light on her face. Dynamic depth, energetic cool color palette, high clarity, futuristic but real.
lessons.alt: A Black woman security engineer scans a server rack with a tablet in a bright data center glowing with cyan and violet light.

lessons.prompt: Bright, airy modern software studio with floor-to-ceiling windows, city view, green plants and white desks in natural daylight. A smiling Black woman developer in her thirties in a coral top points at a large monitor showing a colorful abstract flow diagram of connected boxes and lines, while a young Black man in a mustard sweater leans in beside her, both engaged and expressive. Clean, modern, energetic, rich color accents of teal, coral and yellow.
lessons.alt: A Black woman developer points at a colorful diagram on a monitor while a colleague leans in, in a bright, plant-filled studio.

lessons.prompt: Aspirational sunny afternoon on a tree-lined suburban street: two attractive modern homes side by side with manicured green lawns under a bright blue sky. In the foreground a confident Black couple in their thirties in smart casual clothes stand on the sidewalk comparing details on a tablet with a friendly Black woman real estate agent in a navy blazer, all smiling and engaged, faces clearly visible. Crisp, professional, optimistic, natural color.
lessons.alt: A Black couple and their real estate agent compare details on a tablet in front of two modern homes on a sunny street.

lessons.prompt: Bright modern financial district plaza at midday, glass skyscrapers reflecting a clear blue sky, people walking in the sun. A confident Black woman investor in her forties in a tailored camel coat stands in the foreground looking at her phone, which shows an abstract green and blue line chart, a thoughtful half-smile on her clearly lit face. Clean, aspirational, modern, crisp daylight with rich blues and natural skin tones.
lessons.alt: A Black woman investor checks a chart on her phone in a sunny financial district surrounded by glass towers.

lessons.prompt: Joyful, bright storybook-colored photograph: a cheerful Black girl about five years old in a sunny yellow dress sits in a lush green meadow full of colorful wildflowers, both hands raised happily as she counts on her fingers, big open smile. Butterflies, a soft rainbow and fluffy white clouds in a bright blue sky, bright midday sunshine. Vivid, playful, warm, full of wonder at creation.
lessons.alt: A smiling Black girl in a yellow dress counts on her fingers in a sunny meadow of wildflowers under a rainbow.

lessons.prompt: Bright, cheerful classroom table by a large sunny window: a Black boy and a Black girl about eight years old laugh together as they count five golden bread rolls and two small colorful toy fish beside a wicker basket, with rainbow-colored wooden counting blocks lined up in front of them. A smiling Black woman teacher leans in to help. Vivid primary colors, soft daylight, joyful and educational.
lessons.alt: Two Black children and their teacher laugh as they count bread rolls, toy fish and colorful blocks at a sunny classroom table.

lessons.prompt: Bright contemporary open-plan office with large windows and a city view in natural daylight. A confident Black man in his forties in a light blue shirt, warm smile, hands a stack of colored sticky notes to a capable young Black woman team lead, while a diverse team gathers around a glass planning wall covered in neatly tiered rows of yellow, coral, green and blue notes. Energetic, collaborative, modern, clean and colorful.
lessons.alt: A Black team leader hands sticky notes to a colleague as their team gathers at a colorful planning wall in a bright office.

lessons.prompt: Bright, sunlit family home office with white walls, bookshelves and green plants, afternoon daylight through a big window. A young Black man in his twenties in a light gray sweater studies an open ledger and a laptop at a light oak table, thoughtful and engaged, while his grandmother, a smiling Black woman in her seventies in a colorful patterned blouse, stands beside him with a hand on his shoulder. Hopeful, generational, clean natural color.
lessons.alt: A young Black man studies the family ledger while his smiling grandmother rests a hand on his shoulder in a sunny home office.

lessons.prompt: Uplifting bright mid-morning on a lush green hillside path above a wide valley of fields and red, white and purple wildflowers, white clouds in a clear blue sky. A Black woman in her forties in a flowing white and soft blue dress walks forward along the path holding an open Bible against her heart, peaceful joyful expression, face clearly lit. Fresh greens, sky blue and clean natural daylight; hopeful, free and full of blessing.
lessons.alt: A Black woman holding an open Bible walks a green hillside path at sunrise above a valley of wildflowers.

topics.label: Grow Your Faith

A small group of Black men, women and children stand together on a grassy hillside with open Bibles, faces clearly visible and lifted in joy, wind in their colorful clothes. Uplifting, wide, open and full of daylight.

A confident Black woman financial planner in her thirties in a royal blue blazer smiles while reviewing an abstract rising green chart on a tablet with a young Black couple at a clean white table. Aspirational, professional, rich blues and warm daylight.

A joyful Black family, mother, father and two young children, stand on the front steps of their new home as the father holds up a set of house keys, everyone laughing.
